knownFalsePositives: Approved change windows; documented automation service principals; sandbox accounts excluded via lookup.
detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud with search access to `index=gcp`.
• Install and configure Splunk Add-on for Google Cloud Platform (`Splunk_TA_google-cloudplatform`, Splunkbase 3088) with the modular input for `google:gcp:audit`.
• Prerequisite crawl UC(s): UC-4.3.41.
• Confirm field extractions in `props.conf` for `protoPayload.methodName` and related actor fields.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Export Cloud Audit Logs to Pub/Sub; configure `Splunk_TA_google-cloudplatform` Pub/Sub input into `index=gcp`. Validate protoPayload.methodName extractions.
Validate ingest before alerting:
```spl
index=gcp sourcetype="google:gcp:audit" | stats count by sourcetype
```

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
```spl
index=gcp sourcetype="google:gcp:audit" (protoPayload.methodName="*artifactregistry.repositories.upload*" OR protoPayload.methodName="artifactregistry.repositories.upload")
| table _time protoPayload.methodName protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail resourceName
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.3.150_gcp_artifact_registry_up_150"
| sort -_time
```

Understanding this SPL
Scopes `google:gcp:audit` in `index=gcp` to detect gcp artifact registry upload. Tune thresholds to your change cadence; exclude break-glass principals and sandbox accounts via a lookup.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare to the GCP Logs Explorer console for the same 24-hour window. Confirm row counts and `protoPayload.methodName` values match the vendor console. Run `| fieldsummary` on a 1-hour sample to verify extractions.

Step 4 — Operationalize and troubleshoot
Save as `4_3_150_alert` with severity aligned to `high` criticality. Dashboard: Events list, methodName timeline, principalEmail table..
Failure modes: (1) no events — verify modular input/API credentials and index routing; (2) empty actor fields — upgrade Splunk Add-on for Google Cloud Platform (`Splunk_TA_google-cloudplatform`, Splunkbase 3088) and review alias mappings; (3) API throttling — reduce poll frequency or enable queue buffering; (4) alert fatigue — tune thresholds and document exclusions in knownFalsePositives.
